title: sos_signature.json: regenerate with real pinned Schnorr48 key + AddrForKey transcript
description: Fixture slice of b7z9.121. test/vectors/sos_signature.json is descriptive-only (placeholder keys); only Rust pins a real transcript digest. Regenerate with a real pinned Ed25519/Schnorr48 keypair, the AddrForKey-derived 16-octet origin IPv6 (post upstream-yggdrasil-addressing), a real canonical-CBOR SOS payload, and real signature bytes so all three stacks verify against the same oracle. Include a silent-drop (error_response:false) invalid-signature case. Independent oracle: sign with the python schnorr48 reference impl, verify vectors with Rust/C - never derive expected bytes from the code under test. Land with the address slices since the transcript covers the origin address.
